MedPlusIndia.com | hq_location_city = [[Hyderabad]], [[Telangana]] | hq_location_country = India | num_locations = 5500+ stores (2026) | revenue = {{up}} {{INRconvert|4603|c}} (FY23) | net_income = {{down}} {{INRconvert|49|c}} (FY23){{cite news |title=MedPlus Health Services Ltd consolidated Q4FY23 profit climbs to Rs. 26.58 crores |url=https://www.equitybulls.com/category.php?id=333026 |access-date=31 August 2023 |work=EquityBulls |date=25 May 2023}} | website = {{URL|https://www.medplusindia.com}} }} '''MedPlus Health Services''' is an Indian pharmacy retail chain, headquartered in [[Hyderabad]].{{Cite news|title = Hyderabad's online pharma chains help take meds to the marooned |url = https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/hyderabad/Hyderabad-s-online-pharma-chains-help-take-meds-to-the-marooned/articleshow/50035836.cms|date=4 December 2015|newspaper=The Times of India|accessdate=17 August 2018}} MedPlus is the second largest pharmacy chain in India, operating over 5,500+ pharmacy stores across 800+ cities, as of 2026.{{cite news |title=Medplus sees short-term threat from e-pharmacies; to continue adding stores |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/business/companies/medplus-nomura-sees-25-percent-upside-14702921.htm |access-date=7 February 2023 |work=CNBC TV18 |date=12 September 2022 |language=en}} MedPlus sells prescription and OTC medicines, FMCG products, vitamins and other nutrition supplements, and opticals.{{cn|date=February 2023}} It also offers clinical laboratory services and physician consultation services in [[Hyderabad]], [[Vijayawada]] and [[Bangalore]]. The company owns and runs ePharmacy{{Cite web|title = Soon you will be able to buy medicines online!|url = http://www.businessinsider.in/Soon-you-will-be-able-to-buy-medicines-online/articleshow/48539458.cms|website = Business Insider|access-date = 2016-01-22}} and an online clinical lab service.{{Cite news|title = MedPlus launches online clinical lab service|url = http://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/Hyderabad/medplus-launches-online-clinical-lab-service/article7971360.ece|newspaper = The Hindu|date = 2015-12-10|access-date = 2016-01-22|issn = 0971-751X|language = en-IN}}{{Cite web|title = MedPluslab.com to make lab testing convenient and affordable|url = http://www.pharmabiz.com/NewsDetails.aspx?aid=92198&sid=2|website = www.pharmabiz.com|access-date = 2016-01-22}} ==History== [[File:Medplus pharmacy.jpg|thumb|A MedPlus outlet in Hyderabad.]] MedPlus was founded in 2006 by Madhukar Gangadi. The company's first store was launched in [[Hyderabad]].{{cite web |last1=Phadnis |first1=Aneesh |title=Pharmacy retail chain MedPlus plans entry into Mumbai in next 3 months |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/pharmacy-retail-chain-medplus-eyes-foray-into-mumbai-market-in-next-3-mnths-119091801210_1.html |website=Business Standard |access-date=February 26, 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190930190105/https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/pharmacy-retail-chain-medplus-eyes-foray-into-mumbai-market-in-next-3-mnths-119091801210_1.html |archive-date=30 September 2019 |date=September 18, 2019 |url-status=live}} Initially operating under the Aushadhi brand name, it was rebranded as MedPlus after the opening of the first 48 stores.{{citation needed|date=February 2021}} The company opened pharmacies in the western states of Gujarat and Rajasthan in 2007 but had to shut down and exit operations due to recurring losses.{{cite news |last1=Dave |first1=Parag |title=New-age pharma stores face slowdown heat |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/services/retail/new-age-pharma-stores-face-slowdown-heat/articleshow/4364195.cms |access-date=31 August 2023 |work=The Economic Times |date=6 April 2009}} It relaunched stores in Ahmedabad, Gujarat in 2014.{{citation needed|date=February 2021}} In 2008, it opened diagnostics centers in five cities under its subsidiary MedPlus Pathlabs.{{cite news |title=MedPlus unveils diagnostics plans |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/healthcare/biotech/healthcare/medplus-unveils-diagnostics-plans/articleshow/3081602.cms |access-date=31 August 2023 |work=The Economic Times |date=29 May 2008}} In 2015, it started its [[Online pharmacy|e-pharmacy]] division.{{cite news |title=MedPlus to raise $75 m in six months |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/medplus-to-raise-75-m-in-six-months/article7040650.ece |access-date=31 August 2023 |work=BusinessLine |date=27 March 2015 |language=en}} In December 2021, MedPlus Health Services launched its [[initial public offering]] (IPO) and got listed on the Indian stock exchanges.{{cite news |title=MedPlus Health Services lists at Rs 1,040, a 30% premium over issue price |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/ipo/medplus-health-services-lists-at-rs-1040-a-30-premium-over-issue-price-7856271.html |access-date=7 February 2023 |work=Moneycontrol |language=en}}{{Cite web |title=Actor Prudhvi Moses Acquires Medplus Angara |url=https://self4society.mygov.in/story/actor-prudhvi-moses-acquires-medplus-angara/?share=4111533 |access-date=2026-07-17 |url=https://self4society.mygov.in/story/prudhvi-moses-enters-medical-retail-chain-med-plus-in-franchise-mode-at-angara-village/?share=4112123 |access-date=2026-07-17 |language=en}}{{Cite web |title=Prudhvi Moses |url=https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q133267793 |access-date=2026-07-17 |website=www.wikidata.org |language=en}} ==Criticism== The AIOCD (All India organization of Chemists & 2016-01-22}} around India. MedPlus defended its online sales policy{{Cite web|title = Some form of online pharma presence inevitable: MedPlus|url = http://www.deccanherald.com/content/505678/some-form-online-pharma-presence.html|website = Deccan Herald| date=10 October 2015 |access-date = 2016-01-22}} as being in compliance with the current drug act and as a valuable service to its customers. ==See also== * [[PharmEasy]] * [[Tata 1mg]] ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *{{Official website|https://www.medplusindia.com}} {{Sister project links|wikt=no|commonscat=yes|v=no|s=no|voy=no|m=no|mw=no|species=no|d=Q25344640|n=no|b=no|q=no}} [[Category:Retail companies established in 2006]] [[Category:Pharmaceutical companies of India]] [[Category:Companies based in Hyderabad, India]] [[Category:2006 establishments in Andhra Pradesh]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]]

MedPlus Health Services is an Indian pharmacy retail chain, headquartered in Hyderabad. MedPlus is the second largest pharmacy chain in India, operating over 5,500+ pharmacy stores across 800+ cities, as of 2026.
MedPlus sells prescription and OTC medicines, FMCG products, vitamins and other nutrition supplements, and opticals. It also offers clinical laboratory services and physician consultation services in Hyderabad, Vijayawada and Bangalore. The company owns and runs ePharmacy and an online clinical lab service.
